note: Serving rates for the two student kinds, derived from instance-hour prices (USD per hour: t3.medium 0.0416 from the platform's deployment cost planner; one NVIDIA A10G on Modal 1.1016, Modal's list price for the A10 at 0.000306/s, https://modal.com/pricing, read 2026-09-27). Labelled 'estimated' in every report until billing exists; measured latency is reported beside them. Formula: hourly_rate / (throughput_per_second * 3600 * utilization) * unit.

cpu-classifier.assumptions: t3.medium at $0.0416/h serving a small encoder classifier at 20 requests/s sustained with 25% average utilization: 0.0416 / (20 * 3600 * 0.25) * 1000 = 0.00231

gpu-small-llm.assumptions: one NVIDIA A10G on Modal (the accelerator the platform serves vLLM students on) at $1.1016/h serving a <=3B-parameter model at 300 output tokens/s aggregate with batching and 25% average utilization: 1.1016 / (300 * 3600 * 0.25) * 1e6 = 4.080. Excludes the container's CPU and memory, prefill tokens and an always-on replica.
